spans.s:
m. (-पः)
A king, a sovereign.
E.
नृ man, पा to protect, aff. ड.

f. (-तिः)
Royal policy.
E.
नृप, नीति policy.

m. (-तिः)
1 A name of

KUVERA.
2

A king, a sovereign.
E.
नृ man, and पति a master.

m. (-मः)
A tree, (Cassia fistula.)
E.
नृप, and द्रम a tree.

m. (-यः)
A thorny species of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.)
E.
नृप a king, and प्रिय fond of.

n. (-रं)
A royal palace.
E.
नृप a king, and मन्दिर a residence.

m. (-नः)
Sound of musick, made to give warning to kings when eating or feasting.
E.
नृप, and मान measure.

n. (-क्ष्म)
1 The royal umbrella.
2 Any of the royal insignia.
E.
नृप a king, and लक्ष्मन् a mark or sign.

n. (ङ्गं)
Any emblem or mark of royalty.
E.
नृप, and लिङ्ग mark.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Assuming the insignia of sovereignty.
2 Taking, (fraudulently,) the emblem or marks of the royal or military caste.
E.
नृपलिङ्ग, and धर who has.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
A king's friend.
f. (-भा)
A queen.
E.
नृप, and वल्लभ beloved.

m. (-यः)
Service of princes.
E.
नृप, and संश्रय dependance.

n. (-भं)
1 An assembly of princes.
2 A palace.
E.
नृप a king, and सभा an assembly.

m. (-शः)
Revenue, the royal portion; of grain, a sixth, eight, or twelfth; of fruits, &c. a sixth; and of merchandise a fiftieth.
E.
नृप, and अंश a part.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Of royal birth.
m. (-जः)
A prince.
f. (-जा)
1 A bitter gourd.
2 A princess.
E.
नृप a king, and आत्मज offspring.

m. (-रः)
A sort of sacrifice; the Rājasūya, held by a lord paramount, in which all the offices are performed by tributary princes.
E.
नृप a king, अध्वर a sacrifice.

n. (-रं)
Music played at the royal meals.

m. (-यः)
Consumption.
E.
नृप, and आमय disease.

n. (-र्त्तं)
A kind of gem.
E.
नृप, and आवर्त्त what revolves.

n. (-नं)
A throne.
E.
नृप a king, and आसन a seat.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Kingly, princely, suited to a king.
E.
नृप, and उचित proper.
